peers.name: PFIZER INC
peers.rationale: Large-cap global pharma with broad primary care and oncology portfolio, comparable R&D-driven model and patent-cliff dynamics to AstraZeneca.

peers.name: Merck & Co., Inc.
peers.rationale: Major diversified pharma with strong oncology (Keytruda) and vaccines franchise, similar innovation-driven growth profile and payer exposure as AZN.

peers.name: BRISTOL MYERS SQUIBB CO
peers.rationale: Oncology and immunology-focused pharma of similar scale, facing comparable biosimilar/patent expiry pressures and pipeline replacement dynamics.

peers.name: ELI LILLY & Co
peers.rationale: Global innovator pharma with overlapping therapeutic areas (diabetes, oncology, immunology) and similar reliance on branded drug pricing power.

peers.name: NOVARTIS AG
peers.rationale: European-headquartered global pharma with comparable oncology, respiratory and biologics exposure and similar international regulatory footprint to AZN.

peers.name: Sanofi
peers.rationale: European big pharma peer with overlapping vaccines, immunology and rare disease franchises, similar geographic revenue mix to AstraZeneca.

peers.name: GSK plc
peers.rationale: UK-based global pharma competitor with overlapping respiratory, vaccines and oncology businesses, close comparator on geography and payer dynamics.

peers.name: JOHNSON & JOHNSON
peers.rationale: Pharma segment is comparable in scale and innovation focus, though JNJ's medtech and consumer divisions make this only a partial fit for full-company multiples.
